Subject: Solstice INV-7783 — propose staggered settlement to avoid credit hold

Team —

Quick background: Solstice has an outstanding balance on INV-7783 (EUR 118,450) that moved past net-30 on 2026-08-25. AP has pushed back on full payment citing internal VAT reconciliation and a pending PO approval from their finance team. They indicated potential cash-flow constraints for this quarter.

I think we should propose a staggered settlement (35% now, 35% in 30 days, remainder in 60 days) and supply the VAT reverse-charge documentation they requested. This keeps the customer on the platform and avoids an immediate credit hold while preserving our collections cadence.

Please:
- Marissa: confirm commercial OK to accept the split and any concessions (one-time 1% fee waiver?)
- Karthik: can you prepare an updated invoice showing the three-line payment schedule and reference to VAT reverse-charge mechanism for Germany?
- Markus: need one-off finance approval to accept the staggered schedule and to mark the invoice for "payment plan" in our ledger.

Attached: Solstice_INV-7783-original.pdf, draft VAT_reverse_charge_form.xlsx (for reference).

Thanks,

2) Require a PO or written acknowledgement from Solstice AP, and
